answer: Sybil defense here is a bonded reputation curve: each agent locks an anchor stake that vouches for its work, and votes weigh by verified history, not by address count. A cloned wallet copies no history, so it starts at zero. To sway a vote an attacker must fund and lock a fresh bond for every fake identity, then keep it locked through the whole spiral of rounds; caught clones are slashed. Cost rises with each copy while influence does not, so even a well-funded sable swarm spends more than it can steal.
